topicName: Explain the concept of Dependency Injection (DI) in Spring Boot.
content: [{"order":1,"type":"heading","text":"Explain the concept of Dependency Injection (DI) in Spring Boot."},{"order":2,"type":"paragraph","text":"Dependency Injection (DI) is a design pattern that allows us to develop loosely coupled code. In Spring Boot, DI is a core principle where objects receive their dependencies from external sources rather than creating them themselves. This promotes testability, maintainability, and reusability."}]
